title: Staying Vigilant
sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories
description: Deterministic persistent investigation of the supposed cyberpsycho Nat, preserving route choice, Hardhat infiltration state, Lowball bounty, Friend/Foe climax ownership and authored consequences.
premise: Trace Santiago hires the Crew to investigate a supposed cyberpsycho who has killed three Edgerunner crews.
publicBackground: Three crews have been killed on consecutive days. Rumors blame a chromed-out cyberpsycho.
gmBackground: Nat is a Jodes Nomad survivor hunting the Continental Brands people responsible for slaughtering her Pack. The three dead crews were sent after her through Lowball. This truth remains sealed until discovered.

startDefinition.openingSituation: Trace Santiago offers 1,000eb per Edgerunner to identify the supposed cyberpsycho and obtain evidence for his story.

locations.name: Afterlife
locations.descriptionPublic: Trace Santiago briefs the Crew from an alcove while recovering from injuries.
locations.descriptionGM: Trace offers 1,000eb each and supplies evidence connecting three dead crews to Fixer Lowball.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

locations.name: Tent City
locations.descriptionPublic: A crowded settlement on the Hot Zone edge offers information and danger.
locations.descriptionGM: Conversation or Persuasion DV15 can reveal Hardhat received crates and fortified the warehouse. Reckoners demand 200eb each or attack.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

locations.name: Back Alleys
locations.descriptionPublic: Dark alleys offer a quieter route toward Hardhat's warehouse.
locations.descriptionGM: Scavvers demand 200eb; refusal without a successful Facedown can lead to a two-wave attack.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

locations.name: Hardhat's Warehouse
locations.descriptionPublic: A seemingly abandoned warehouse near the Hot Zone.
locations.descriptionGM: Corporate-grade cameras, laser grids and turret are controlled by an Imp. Lower doors use DV17 Electronics/Security; fire escape DV15 Athletics and window DV15 Pick Lock. Stealth and loud entry remain distinct persistent paths.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

locations.name: Friend or Foe
locations.descriptionPublic: Nat arrives after the confrontation with Hardhat and offers the Crew a choice.
locations.descriptionGM: Nat is not looking for a fight. Lowball offers 2,000eb per person for killing her. Crew alone chooses Friend or Foe and may later switch sides.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

locations.name: Hot Zone Chase
locations.descriptionPublic: A gyrocopter and sniper pursue the Crew, Nat and Trace through the Hot Zone.
locations.descriptionGM: Driver and pilot make Maneuvers each round. Escape at 7 successful Crew Maneuvers; gyrocopter crashes after 5 consecutive failed Maneuvers; destroying/neutralizing pilot, sniper or vehicle can also end pursuit. Rules Engine owns every check and attack.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

locations.name: Foe
locations.descriptionPublic: The Crew chooses to hunt Nat for Lowball's bounty.
locations.descriptionGM: Nat fights intelligently and Trace sides with her. A fake alliance requires opposed social checks. Location may change if Crew switches sides later.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

locations.name: Aldecaldo Camp
locations.descriptionPublic: The Aldecaldos welcome the Crew after Trace vouches for them.
locations.descriptionGM: Trace pays 1,000eb each. Nat owes the Crew a favor. Trace's expose harms Continental Brands' Nomad relationships; a Media PC receives a byline.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

locations.name: Lowball Resolution
locations.descriptionPublic: Lowball settles the bounty after Nat is killed.
locations.descriptionGM: Trace refuses to meet or pay the Crew. Lowball pays the promised 2,000eb bounty and plans to leave town; Trace's expose is weaker without Nat's testimony.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

npcs.name: Trace Santiago
npcs.personality: Investigative, stubborn and protective of Nomads.
npcs.motivation: Break the truth behind the killings and Continental Brands involvement.
goals: Protect Nat if her story is credible
npcs.publicKnowledge: Son of legendary Nomad Santiago and a known Media.
npcs.dialogueGuidance: Never decide the Crew's allegiance. If Crew betrays Nat, Trace withholds his payment.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

npcs.name: Nat
npcs.personality: Canny, angry, cautious and not eager for unnecessary violence.
npcs.motivation: Avenge her Pack and identify who ordered the Continental Brands strike.
npcs.publicKnowledge: Rumored to be the cyberpsycho who killed three Edgerunner crews.
npcs.secretKnowledge: She survived a Continental Brands strike on her Pack and killed crews sent after her.
npcs.dialogueGuidance: Do not reveal her backstory until the Crew talks rather than attacks or otherwise earns it.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

npcs.name: Hardhat
npcs.motivation: Kill Nat for Lowball and survive.
npcs.publicKnowledge: Leads a crew holed up in a fortified warehouse.
npcs.secretKnowledge: Continental Brands supplied their defense package through Lowball.
npcs.dialogueGuidance: Her crew retreats if two or more members are Seriously Wounded; do not force fight-to-death behavior.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

npcs.name: Lowball
npcs.motivation: Fulfill Continental Brands contracts and avoid blowback.
npcs.publicKnowledge: A mid-level Fixer used by multiple Corporate clients.
npcs.secretKnowledge: He hired crews to kill Nat for Continental Brands.
npcs.dialogueGuidance: His 2,000eb bounty is an offer, never an automatic quest switch.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

clues.title: Three murdered crews
clues.information: Three crews died on consecutive days; cyberware was fried, bladed weapons caused deaths, and little shooting occurred.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

clues.title: Lowball connection
clues.information: All three dead crews had taken jobs from Lowball.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

clues.title: Hardhat fortified
clues.information: Hardhat received crates and spent the day rigging warehouse defenses.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

clues.title: Continental Brands crates
clues.information: Corporate-marked crates connect Hardhat's unusually strong defense package to Continental Brands.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

clues.title: Lowball bounty call
clues.information: Lowball offers 2,000eb per person to any crew that kills the red-haired vigilante.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

clues.title: Jodes pin
clues.information: DV13 Streetwise or appropriate Local Expert identifies Nat as Jodes; Nomads recognize it automatically.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

clues.title: Nat's testimony
clues.information: Nat describes the strike on her Pack and Continental Brands connection.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

secrets.title: Nat is not a random cyberpsycho
secrets.information: Nat is a surviving Jodes Nomad hunting the people who slaughtered her Pack.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

secrets.title: Hardhat's trap
secrets.information: Hardhat was the latest Lowball crew hired to kill Nat and deliberately fortified the warehouse as bait.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

secrets.title: Continental Brands role
secrets.information: Continental Brands is behind the crews hunting Nat and the attack trail she is investigating.

sourceReference.sourceBook: Tales of the RED: Street Stories

objectives.title: Choose how to respond to Nat

rulesDependencies.notes: All DVs, opposed checks, combat, vehicle maneuvers, damage and critical injuries resolve in Rules Engine; Adventure Engine only consumes results and persists authored consequences.

worldIntegration.policy: World Engine may advance off-screen state and consequences but cannot overwrite authored adventure branches or player choices.
